This milestone will produce a written progress report summarizing key achievements, challenges, and next steps from the first phase of MVP development. It will be accompanied by a video presentation featuring the project team discussing the report’s highlights, offering insights into the development process, team dynamics, and technical progress made so far.

Documentation:
・written product design overview
・spreadsheet outlining projected costs and resources allocation
・and last but not least, a structured project plan mapping out phases, timelines to guide development.

Video:
・team update showcasing code and features

The documentation and video will touch on the following points:
・Product concept explanation
・Types of Users / User Journey
・Core feature descriptions
・Build Progress

The draft is written in English and will be anything from 1-5 pages. The video will be 1-5 minutes.
